name: clic-moda-scz
description: Orquestador del monorepo Clic Moda SCZ. Cada proyecto es independiente (su propio package.json, lockfile y node_modules); aquí solo se coordinan.

scripts.password:reset: node scripts/orchestrate.mjs run api -- pnpm --dir services/api password:reset
scripts.dev: pnpm preflight && concurrently -k -n api,admin,shop -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:admin" "pnpm dev:shop"
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/orchestrate.mjs run api -- pnpm --dir services/api dev
scripts.dev:admin: node scripts/orchestrate.mjs run admin -- pnpm --dir apps/admin dev
scripts.dev:shop: node scripts/orchestrate.mjs run shop -- pnpm --dir apps/shop dev
scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir apps/shop install && pnpm --dir apps/admin install && pnpm --dir services/api install
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:shop && pnpm build:admin && pnpm build:api
scripts.lint:all: pnpm --dir apps/shop lint && pnpm --dir apps/admin lint && pnpm --dir services/api lint
scripts.test:all: pnpm test:shop && pnpm test:admin && pnpm test:api
scripts.check: pnpm verify:projects && pnpm secrets:scan && pnpm lint:all && pnpm test:all && pnpm build:all
